title: 第5课 · 我最近越来越胖了
subtitle: HSK 3 · Lesson 5 — 我最近越来越胖了 · I am getting fatter and fatter lately

data.topic: 课文1 · 1. 在小丽家 — At Xiaoli's home

items.en: to have a fever
for

items.zh: 朋友：我听说你身体不舒服，怎么了？
items.py: Péngyou: Wǒ tīngshuō nǐ shēntǐ bù shūfu, zěnme le?
items.en: Friend: I heard you're not feeling well. What's the matter?

items.zh: 小丽：前几天有点儿发烧，现在好多了。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Qián jǐ tiān yǒudiǎnr fā shāo, xiànzài hǎoduō le.
items.en: Xiaoli: I had a bit of a fever a few days ago, but I'm much better now.

items.zh: 朋友：喝杯茶吧，这是我为你买的绿茶，很不错。
items.py: Péngyou: Hē bēi chá ba, zhè shì wǒ wèi nǐ mǎi de lǜchá, hěn bùcuò.
items.en: Friend: Have a cup of tea. This is green tea I bought for you; it's very good.

items.zh: 小丽：谢谢，我要吃药，不喝茶了。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Xièxie, wǒ yào chī yào, bù hē chá le.
items.en: Xiaoli: Thanks, but I have to take medicine, so I won't have tea.

items.py: Péngyou: Nà hē bēi shuǐ ba.
items.en: Friend: Then have a glass of water.
Xiaoli: OK.

data.topic: 课文2 · 2. 在打电话 — On the phone

items.en: to take care of
to need
to catch a cold
Zhang, a surname

items.zh: 周太太：对不起，我明天不能和你们出去玩儿了。
items.py: Zhōu tàitai: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ míngtiān bù néng hé nǐmen chūqu wánr le.
items.en: Mrs. Zhou: Sorry, I can't go out with you tomorrow after all.

items.py: Zhāng tàitai: Wèi shénme? Zěnme le?
items.en: Mrs. Zhang: Why? What happened?

items.zh: 周太太：我儿子生病了，我要在家照顾他。
items.py: Zhōu tàitai: Wǒ érzi shēng bìng le, wǒ yào zài jiā zhàogù tā.
items.en: Mrs. Zhou: My son is ill; I have to stay home and look after him.

items.zh: 张太太：他吃药了吗？要不要去医院？
items.py: Zhāng tàitai: Tā chī yào le ma? Yào bu yào qù yīyuàn?
items.en: Mrs. Zhang: Has he taken any medicine? Does he need to go to the hospital?

items.zh: 周太太：不用去医院，昨天吃了感冒药，现在好一些了。
items.py: Zhōu tàitai: Bù yòng qù yīyuàn, zuótiān chīle gǎnmào yào, xiànzài hǎo yīxiē le.
items.en: Mrs. Zhou: No need for the hospital. He took cold medicine yesterday and he's a bit better now.

items.zh: 张太太：那我们下次再一起出去玩儿吧。
items.py: Zhāng tàitai: Nà wǒmen xià cì zài yīqǐ chūqu wánr ba.
items.en: Mrs. Zhang: Then let's go out together next time.

data.topic: 课文3 · 3. 在小刚家 — At Xiaogang's home

items.en: season
of course
spring
grass
summer
dress, skirt

items.zh: 小丽：你最喜欢哪个季节？
items.py: Xiǎolì: Nǐ zuì xǐhuan nǎge jìjié?
items.en: Xiaoli: Which season do you like best?

items.zh: 小刚：当然是春天，天气不那么冷了，草和树都绿了，花也开了。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Dāngrán shì chūntiān, tiānqì bù nàme lěng le, cǎo hé shù dōu lǜ le, huā yě kāi le.
items.en: Xiaogang: Spring, of course. The weather isn't so cold anymore, the grass and trees turn green, and the flowers bloom.

items.zh: 小丽：我最喜欢夏天，因为我可以穿漂亮的裙子了。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan xiàtiān, yīnwèi wǒ kěyǐ chuān piàoliang de qúnzi le.
items.en: Xiaoli: I like summer best, because I can wear pretty skirts.

items.zh: 小刚：那我也喜欢夏天了。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Nà wǒ yě xǐhuan xiàtiān le.
items.en: Xiaogang: Then now I like summer too.

items.zh: 小丽：怎么？你也有漂亮的裙子？
items.py: Xiǎolì: Zěnme? Nǐ yě yǒu piàoliang de qúnzi?
items.en: Xiaoli: What? You have pretty skirts too?

items.zh: 小刚：不，我喜欢看你穿漂亮的裙子。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Bù, wǒ xǐhuan kàn nǐ chuān piàoliang de qúnzi.
items.en: Xiaogang: No, I like seeing you wear pretty skirts.

data.topic: 课文4 · 4. 在小刚家 — At Xiaogang's home

items.en: lately, recently
more, to a greater degree

items.zh: 小丽：我最近越来越胖了。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Wǒ zuìjìn yuè lái yuè pàng le.
items.en: Xiaoli: I've been getting fatter and fatter lately.

items.zh: 小刚：谁说的？我觉得你越来越漂亮了。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Shéi shuō de? Wǒ juéde nǐ yuè lái yuè piàoliang le.
items.en: Xiaogang: Who says so? I think you're getting prettier and prettier.

items.zh: 小丽：你看，这条裙子是去年买的，今年就不能穿了。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Nǐ kàn, zhè tiáo qúnzi shì qùnián mǎi de, jīnnián jiù bù néng chuān le.
items.en: Xiaoli: Look, I bought this skirt last year, and this year I can't wear it anymore.

items.zh: 小刚：那是因为你吃得太多了，少吃点儿吧。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Nà shì yīnwèi nǐ chī de tài duō le, shǎo chī diǎnr ba.
items.en: Xiaogang: That's because you eat too much. Eat a bit less.

items.zh: 小丽：我做的饭越来越好吃，我能少吃吗？
items.py: Xiǎolì: Wǒ zuò de fàn yuè lái yuè hǎochī, wǒ néng shǎo chī ma?
items.en: Xiaoli: My cooking keeps getting tastier. How could I eat less?

items.py: Shàng ge yuè hěn lěng, xiànzài tiānqì bù nàme lěng le.
items.en: It was very cold last month; now the weather isn't so cold anymore.

items.zh: 我前几天有点儿发烧，现在好多了。
items.py: Wǒ qián jǐ tiān yǒudiǎnr fā shāo, xiànzài hǎoduō le.
items.en: I had a slight fever a few days ago; now I'm much better.
I like summer now.

items.zh: 这条裙子是去年买的，今年就不能穿了。

items.en: I bought this skirt last year, and this year I can't wear it anymore.
